reason: Project lens: not a PROTECTED range (grind_config PROTECT covers only irq1_handler, not_vsync_2ed0, wait_for_vsync_2242 in game.6502), not generated source, not data or a table, not raster-timed (put_on's .room in the renderer, bank 4, double-buffered; the palette split code is in main RAM and does not move). It runs in bank 4 like the old code and reads and writes exactly the same locations (arena_top_lo/hi,X and save_start_lo/hi,Y in bank 4 workspace, mark_part's self-modified operands in bank 4 sideways RAM, v_ptr &C4/&C5 in the renderer's scratch, the header via (v_ptr),Y), so ROMSEL/ANDY/ACCCON X state is irrelevant to the change; only the store order differs, and nothing in an interrupt reads these. DEC v_ptr+1/DEC base_hi/INC header_hi+1 act on values just stored. Exhaustive simulation of every high byte 1-255 and low byte 0-255: start-4, start-8 and start+1 identical to the old 16-bit arithmetic (0 mismatches); exit A=0, Y=4 for line 1382, X unchanged, flags dead. INC A and BRA are 65C02 opcodes already used in render.6502. Room: applied to a scratch copy and assembled with Baron 0.5.3: shipping and bench (DEBUG_LIVES) bank 4 ends &B381 (was &B37D), DEBUG_FULLREDRAW &B3FD, the 7 GAMEPLAY_ flags &B3C8, SKY_HELI=0 &B3FB, all under REN_BASE &B400 with every ASSERT passing (the tightest, the full-redraw oracle, has 3 bytes left). The 4-byte slide of the rest of bank 4 is a performance question for the gate's measurement, not a behaviour change. Recounted: old 72 bytes / 107 cycles, new 76 bytes / 90 cycles on the common path (low byte &08-&FE).
